dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior region and a shorter, parabolic curve toward the anterior head area.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Consistent slate grey; median pixel intensity indicates a uniform, non-white coloration across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse lighter-grey patches and speckles localized primarily on the left lateral-dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradient transitions between the primary grey baseline and lighter textured areas lack sharp defined edges.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear dorsal ridge extending along the posterior midline, resulting in a distinct geometric shadow-casting division of the dorsal surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Well-defined, high-contrast circular aperture at the anterior dorsal apex corresponding to the blowhole location.
